title: Two wizards on Unicorn Way see the same ghost patrol walk its path, and the Commons' wisps and reagents stand on their nodes
notes: 10.14: both accounts are game masters and both wizards enter Unicorn Way, where spawner entries have no position of their own and are placed on a node
of their path. Both go beside Path Ghost02 (nodes from (-10803, 4637) north to y 5838) and each client is shot five times about two seconds apart, so the
same walker can be compared at the same moment on both. The main wizard then travels to the Commons and goes beside Path 86, the mana wisps' path,
to show its wisps and reagents on their nodes rather than at the origin. The pending SQL adds zone_path, zone_path_node and the MobMonsterMagicBehavior row.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added
